name: Qwen2-Audio Technical Report
problem: Audio-language models needed complex hierarchical task tags, which made pre-training data curation brittle and instruction-following weak.
mechanism: Replaces hierarchical tags with NATURAL LANGUAGE PROMPTS describing each data type and task, unifies voice-chat and audio-analysis interaction modes without system-prompt switching, and applies DPO to improve factuality and instruction adherence.
speedup_reported: Reports outperforming prior SOTA including Gemini-1.5-pro on audio-centric instruction-following subsets of AIR-Bench. This is a model-quality claim with no latency, memory or hardware disclosure, so no serving speedup can be extracted.
notes: Technical report, not a peer-reviewed paper; no venue found. Qwen2-Audio weights are widely downloaded and fine-tuned, and Qwen2-Audio-family inference exists in production stacks, but the model's serving cost is dominated by the audio encoder's sequence length, which this report does not characterise. Note the arXiv list shows a much later Qwen-Audio 3.x line (2607.11738 Qwen-Audio-VAE, 2609.07549 Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR, 2609.25176 Realtime) - those are separate technical reports outside this record.
